label: prf:categorical-q-ext-deriv-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of the categorical $q$-exterior derivative
html: Any morphism d' satisfying (1), (2), (3) must agree with d_q on horizontal forms (q^{-1} d by hypothesis) and on vertical forms (d by hypothesis). Since \pi_H + \pi_V = \mathrm{id} (weight decomposition), every form decomposes uniquely as a sum of horizontal and vertical parts, and R-linearity extends d' to the whole space by the formula d' = q^{-1} d \circ \pi_H + d \circ \pi_V = d_q. Hence d' = d_q.
heading: Proof
